task_commit_basis: first parent of https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/commit/adff39507a69b6e1fcb250627e335fd43578cb0d (squash merge); gh api compare a873af307a15...adff39507a69 touches exactly the pull request's files

reference_change.title: fix: eliminate N+1 performance bug in RemoteSandboxService with batch endpoint

workload.source: written here from the description of https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/12105 (search_sandboxes making one runtime API call per sandbox): ten searches over 50 stored sandboxes against an in-process fake runtime API that answers one request at a time after 5 ms, with in-memory SQLite, eval/tasks/workloads/openhands-openhands-pr12105/search_sandboxes.py

oracle.source: OpenHands's RemoteSandboxService tests (changed by https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/12105); targeted tests only

evidence.note: description, as matched by the miner: speedup claims: 10x faster; 50x faster; 100x faster | timings: 0.51s; 0.05s; 2.53s; 5.05s

status_reason: built here and ran workload and oracle on the task and reference trees; see runs. Dependencies are the tree's poetry.lock, exported with poetry 2.1.3 (main and test groups); aiosqlite, which the workload's in-memory database needs, is added at a release from before the change's date
